variants.title: Seasoned rider
variants.alt: Illustrative concept: a seasoned rider wearing wraparound glasses on a parked Harley-Davidson cruiser; based on the supplied HZ0051 reference
variants.description: My first pick: one strong face, prominent glasses and a recognizable Harley. The simplest read at card size. Uses the supplied HZ0051 frame as a visual guide.

variants.title: Coastal rider
variants.alt: Illustrative concept: a woman wearing light-colored protective glasses on a parked burgundy Harley-Davidson cruiser; based on the supplied HZ0044 reference
variants.description: A confident woman rider with clear eyewear and a coastal setting. A useful alternate for the same rally audience. Uses the supplied HZ0044 frame as a visual guide.

variants.title: Rally together
variants.alt: Illustrative concept: a smiling rider couple wearing wraparound glasses beside a parked Harley-Davidson cruiser; based on the supplied HZ0048 reference
variants.description: Shared enthusiasm and a warmer expression. Both pairs of glasses stay visible in the two-thirds panel. Uses the supplied HZ0048 frame as a visual guide.

suppliedPhotos.title: Supplied helmeted couple
suppliedPhotos.alt: Supplied image of a smiling couple in Harley-Davidson helmets and sunglasses on a motorcycle
suppliedPhotos.description: A warm rally image with both pairs of glasses prominent. Slightly below the 300 ppi target; inspect the physical proof before the press run.
